intro: Jobs similar to chief executives are senior management roles that lead one part of a business. By O*NET 31.0 data, the closest are Sales Managers (84% similar), Human Resources Managers (83%) and Financial Managers (83%). Each pays less than the $213,990 chief executive median.
shared: Every job on this list runs people, money and plans at a high level. O*NET rates judgment and decision making at 4.75 out of 5 for chief executives, and the same skill sits at the top of most similar roles. The difference is scope: a CEO answers for the whole organization, while sales, finance, HR or marketing managers own one function. That is why none of the 20 pays more.

faq.q: Can a CEO move into a different management job?
faq.a: Yes, and it is common after a sale or merger. Financial Managers and Marketing Managers are both over 80% similar and earn medians of $166,570 and $166,790, about 22% less than chief executives. Board, advisory and interim roles are not separate careers in this data.

faq.q: Which jobs like chief executive need less preparation?
faq.a: 6 of the 20 similar careers usually need less preparation than chief executives, including Sales Managers, Human Resources Managers and non-retail sales supervisors. Sales supervisors earn $87,520, which is 59% less than the CEO median, so the trade-off is mostly pay.
